api.input_layout: X[T,K], W[N,K] row-major uint16 bits, same format per method
api.output_layout: uint16 Y[T,N], ldy=0 -> N, output_bf16 selectable independently
api.arithmetic: native typed half or BF16 matrix inputs; float accumulator C/D; float beta FMA epilogue; one final typed conversion/store
api.beta: any finite float; beta zero skips old Y reads
api.geometry: T arbitrary positive; N,K positive multiples of 16; ldy=0 or >=N; explicit prelaunch rejection otherwise
api.validation: checked geometry/bytes/launch; alignment 2; registered live Strata device USM span containment and queue domain; output disjoint from both inputs
api.ownership: caller retains input/output allocations and stream until completion; Gemm host calls serialized
api.reference: old BF16/FP16 -> FP32 oneMKL GEMM definitions unmodified

input_local_layouts.B: column-major K32xN32 from contiguous row-major W rows

kernel.accumulator: one 8x16 float joint matrix per subgroup; no global FP32 output/scratch
kernel.tails: predicated zero-filled input SLM, all barriers converged, predicated coordinate stores
kernel.capability_query: cached per Gemm: Intel GPU, subgroup16, WG64, SLM3072 and native input->FP32 C/D tuple 8x16x16; half scalar output also gated
kernel.claims: No occupancy/throughput/native instruction-lowering measurements; Main must inspect compiler/device execution.
